questions.q: You're parking in a new city this weekend. Does your home-city permit cover you there?
options: Yes, a permit is a permit
questions.why: Permits are often city- or county-specific. Check before you park.

questions.q: Holiday hires start Friday. Who needs a food handler card?
questions.why: Many areas require one for anyone handling food, seasonal staff included.

questions.q: The fire suppression inspection is coming up. Who's tracking the date?
questions.why: Inspectors check it. Remembering the date is on you.
